title: Kununu Company Profile Scraper
description: Get Kununu company profiles with employer identity, location, industry, overall score, recommendations, review totals, and website. Batch company slugs by country.

batch.title: Company slugs
batch.description: Kununu company profile slugs to retrieve.
batch.valueDescription: Company Slug used to run this search.

schema.description: Kununu country market code, such as de, at, or ch. Accepted values: de, at, ch.
Company slug from the public Kununu employer profile URL.
Alias for company_slug, for chaining from the search endpoint.
Alias for country (de, at, ch). Accepted values: de, at, ch.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Kununu company profiles by slug and country. Export employer details, locations, industry, overall scores, recommendation rates, and review totals.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve Kununu employer profiles with company identity, location, industry, ratings, recommendation rates, and review totals. Batch company slugs with a selected country.
useCases: Recruiters can review employer ratings and profile information.
Workplace researchers can compare recommendation and review totals.
B2B analysts can enrich employer records with location and industry context.
howToUse: Add a Kununu company slug to each entry in `companies`.
Choose the profile country, such as Germany, Austria, or Switzerland.
Read employer details and ratings from the returned profile object.

faqs.question: How do I find a company slug?
faqs.answer: Search with Kununu Company Search Scraper and copy the slug from its profile URL or result.
